{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011Ccs2uQVLZcHWdyFovkQTX","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01FAd5VPvUaSWCHpYokEVaqi","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > /app/analysis/onset.py << 'EOF'\nimport pandas as pd\nsensors = pd.read_pickle('/app/analysis/sensors.pkl')\nmeta = pd.read_csv('/app/dataset/sensor_metadata.csv').set_index('sensor_id')\n\ndef get_runs(df):\n    df = df.reset_index(drop=True)\n    runs = []\n    cur_val = None\n    start = None\n    count = 0\n    start_idx = None\n    for i, row in df.iterrows():\n        v = row['out_of_range']\n        if v != cur_val:\n            if cur_val is not None:\n                runs.append((cur_val, start, df.loc[i-1,'utc_ts'], count, start_idx, i-1))\n            cur_val = v\n            start = row['utc_ts']\n            count = 1\n            start_idx = i\n        else:\n            count += 1\n    runs.append((cur_val, start, df.loc[len(df)-1,'utc_ts'], count, start_idx, len(df)-1))\n    return runs\n\nresults = {}\nfor sid, grp in sensors.groupby('sensor_id'):\n    grp = grp.sort_values('utc_ts').reset_index(drop=True)\n    runs = get_runs(grp)\n    out_runs = [r for r in runs if r[0]]\n    # find first run with length >=5\n    candidate = None\n    for r in out_runs:\n        if r[3] >= 5:\n            candidate = r\n            break\n    delay = meta.loc[sid, 'response_delay_minutes']\n    onset_observed = candidate[1] if candidate else None\n    onset_physical = onset_observed -
